name: Create Rental Application Attachment
description: Add an attachment to a rental application

pathParams.name: RentalApplicationId
pathParams.description: The rental application to which the file will be attached

attributes.name: File
attributes.description: The file's bytes, sent as a multipart file part named "File" with its filename and MIME type. Do NOT put a path string here: pass the local file via call_endpoint's `file` argument, e.g. file: { path: "C:/scans/invoice.pdf" }.

responseFields.name: Id
responseFields.description: Unique identifier of the rental application attachment
